facts.text: The user requested a markdown table in English.
The user requested ten popular jargon terms used in a knowledge graph.
The user requested the list sorted by frequent use.
The user requested each table row to have six columns.
The user specified column 1 as Jargon.
The user specified column 2 as Simple Explanation with a max of 8 words.
The user specified column 3 as Description with a min of 15 words and max of 50 words.
The user specified column 4 as Association score with a knowledge graph keyword.
The user specified column 5 as Citation frequency.
The user specified column 6 as Reference.
